parameters.name: AdditionalAttributes
parameters.description: The list of advanced features to return for instance types.

parameters.name: CpuArchitecture
parameters.description: The CPU architecture. Valid values:

parameters.name: CpuArchitectures
parameters.description: The specified CPU architectures to query. Array length: 1 to 2.

parameters.name: GPUSpec
parameters.description: The GPU type.

parameters.name: GpuSpecs
parameters.description: The specified GPU types to query. Array length: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: InstanceCategories
parameters.description: The specified instance type categories to query. Array length: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: InstanceCategory
parameters.description: The instance type category. Valid values:

parameters.name: InstanceFamilyLevel
parameters.description: The level of the instance family. Valid values:

parameters.name: InstanceTypeFamilies
parameters.description: The specified instance families to query. Array length: 1 to 10.

parameters.name: InstanceTypeFamily
parameters.description: The instance family to which the instance type belongs. For more information, see [DescribeInstanceTypeFamilies](~~25621~~).

parameters.name: InstanceTypes
parameters.description: The specified instance types. Array length: 1 to 10. If this parameter is not specified, information about all instance types is queried by default.

parameters.name: LocalStorageCategories
parameters.description: The specified local disk types. Array length: 1 to 2.

parameters.name: LocalStorageCategory
parameters.description: The local disk type. For more information, see [Local disks](~~63138#section_n2w_8yc_5u1~~). Valid values:

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 1600. This parameter is used for paging.

parameters.name: MaximumCpuCoreCount
parameters.description: The expected maximum number of vCPU cores when querying instance types. Valid values: positive integers.

parameters.name: MaximumCpuSpeedFrequency
parameters.description: The expected maximum clock speed when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MaximumCpuTurboFrequency
parameters.description: The expected maximum turbo frequency when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MaximumGPUAmount
parameters.description: The expected maximum number of GPUs when querying instance types. Valid values: positive integers.

parameters.name: MaximumMemorySize
parameters.description: The expected maximum memory size when querying instance types. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: MinimumBaselineCredit
parameters.description: The expected minimum baseline vCPU computing performance (sum of all vCPUs) for burstable instances t5 and t6 when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumCpuCoreCount
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of vCPU cores when querying instance types. Valid values: positive integers.

parameters.name: MinimumCpuSpeedFrequency
parameters.description: The expected minimum clock speed when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumCpuTurboFrequency
parameters.description: The expected minimum turbo frequency when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumDiskQuantity
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of cloud disks that can be attached when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumEniIpv6AddressQuantity
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of IPv6 addresses per Elastic Network Interface (ENI) when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumEniPrivateIpAddressQuantity
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of IPv4 addresses per Elastic Network Interface (ENI) when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumEniQuantity
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) that can be attached when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumEriQuantity
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of Elastic RDMA Interfaces (ERIs) when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumGPUAmount
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of GPUs when querying instance types. Valid values: positive integers.

parameters.name: MinimumInitialCredit
parameters.description: The expected minimum initial vCPU credits for burstable instances t5 and t6 when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumInstanceBandwidthRx
parameters.description: The expected minimum inbound internal bandwidth when querying instance types. Unit: kbit/s.

parameters.name: MinimumInstanceBandwidthTx
parameters.description: The expected minimum outbound internal bandwidth when querying instance types. Unit: kbit/s.

parameters.name: MinimumInstancePpsRx
parameters.description: The expected minimum inbound packet forwarding rate over the internal network when querying instance types. Unit: pps.

parameters.name: MinimumInstancePpsTx
parameters.description: The expected minimum outbound packet forwarding rate over the internal network when querying instance types. Unit: pps.

parameters.name: MinimumLocalStorageAmount
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of local disks attached to the instance when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumLocalStorageCapacity
parameters.description: The capacity of each local disk attached to the instance. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: MinimumMemorySize
parameters.description: The expected minimum memory size when querying instance types. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: MinimumPrimaryEniQueueNumber
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of default queues for the primary ENI when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumQueuePairNumber
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of QueuePair (QP) queues per Elastic RDMA Interface (ERI) when querying instance types.

parameters.name: MinimumSecondaryEniQueueNumber
parameters.description: The expected minimum number of default queues for the secondary Elastic Network Interface (ENI) when querying instance types.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first call.

parameters.name: NvmeSupport
parameters.description: Specifies whether the cloud disks attached to the instance type support NVMe. Valid values:

parameters.name: PhysicalProcessorModel
parameters.description: The processor model.

parameters.name: PhysicalProcessorModels
parameters.description: The specified processor models to query. Array length: 1 to 10.
